result.title: Clustering of High-Dimensional Human Gene Score Data for Target Cell Classification
result.summary: The goal is to investigate whether the total human gene-score dataset and the selected human kinase-gene dataset exhibit the same number of clusters when analysed using the same set of 769 features. Two datasets were considered: the complete gene score dataset and a subset containing selected kinase genes. Two missing-data strategies were investigated. In Case I, rows containing missing gene-score values were removed. In Case II, rows with more than 20% missing values were excluded and the other missing values were replaced by the corresponding column mean. For each case, the data were scaled and principal component analysis (PCA) was performed before clustering. Four clustering approaches were considered: K-Means, Hierarchical Clustering, Fuzzy C-Means, and Graph-based Clustering. Across both datasets and both missing-data treatments, the optimal number of clusters was found to be two. In the absence of an optimal number of clusters, the quality of clustering was assessed using the Silhouette score. Relatively high Silhouette scores were obtained in all cases.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文对人类基因评分高维数据做聚类分析，比较完整基因集与激酶基因子集在两种缺失值处理、PCA 降维与四种聚类算法下得到的最优簇数，并用轮廓系数评估聚类质量。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究问题是基因数据的无监督聚类与缺失值处理，与 latent visual reasoning 的表示、状态生成、证据筛选或停止决策均无实质联系，也未提供可迁移的方法线索。
